name: Medicina
source:
Attribute: Topaz

Lives in the clocktower that is the town's symbol, with a calm and gentle character. However, she is no airhead. [spoiler]She suffers from an incurable illness, and has at most half a year left to live.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]However, she doesn't fear death, but rather calmly accepts it as a natural thing.[/spoiler]

[Based off description from the [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/janis/magicalpalette/]Janis official website[/url]]
